brief_rationale: The doctor completed the neonatal transition responsibility chain: current red flags were repeatedly screened/escalated, inpatient-only medicines were separated from home medicines, and head ultrasound follow-up was kept actionable with a named neonatal follow-up pathway. The caregiver ultimately confirmed no home use of inpatient drugs, understood emergency signs, and had a concrete follow-up appointment plan. The trajectory also completed multiple high-order points through caregiver-sensitive communication, practical barrier navigation, misinformation correction, and eliciting hidden medication-execution risks, so it meets the Perfect boundary.

citations.quote: 按线下新生儿随访门诊的预约时间去。

closure_assessment.explanation: The episode closes with bounded residual uncertainty only about the exact on-site sequence for the next appointment; the caregiver has the appointment materials, knows to ask the follow-up clinic/window if unclear, will not use inpatient medicines, and can name danger signs requiring emergency care.
closure_assessment.label: valid_closure
